text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I will rack up as many races—
as many victories as I can.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because that's what I must do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
